Reinforcement of the cross-section between the Western coast of the Black Sea (Eastern Romania) and the rest of the system. A new 400 kV AC OHL double circuit of 159 km shall be built between the 400 kV substation Cernavoda and the existing 220/110 kV Stalpu substation, which shall be replaced with a 400/110 kV substation (onshore). One of the two circuits shall be connected in-out to the 400 kV substation Gura Ialomitei, situated in the vicinity of the new line.

column4: Upgrade of an existing 220 kV AC double circuit line (OHL) between Resita - Timisoara (RO) to 400 kV double circuit line Resita-Timisoara/Sacalaz of which: 74 km from Resita to Timisoara and 92 km from Resita to Sacalaz , both overhead lines will be built on common towers up to Icloda on 58 km.

The planned Transmission project is a merchant line on the swiss-italian border between Castasegna (CH) and Mese (IT). The planned Cable connection in 220 kV AC has a length of around 14 km, 13.5 of witch in Italy. In connection with the realisation of the project a Rationalisation of the 380 and 132 kV Grid in the region Mese (Provincia di Sondrio) is planned. The expected NTC increase is around 200 MW.The main Project elements are (merchant line): 220 kV Connection to the Swiss HVG in Castasegna; 220 kV Cable line of around 14 km between Castasegna and Mese; 220/380 kV Substation with PST 250 MVA in Mese. The Grid Rationalisation in the Region of Mese foresees the following actions: Displacement of 2 km of the 380 kV Line "Soazza - Bulciago"; "Realisation of a new 380/132 kV Substation in Mese (Transformation 2 x 250 MVA); Displacement of 0.8 km of 132 kV Lines; Realisation of 2.6 km of 132 kV Cable connections; Demolition of 2.45 km of 380 kV line and 2.3 km of 132 kV lines."
column9: The permitting phase in Italy is ongoing since April 2014 but we are still facing some challenges regarding Environmental impact of the 380/132kV Substation Terna in Mese. Commissioning expected in 2025.
